about: Home Assistant, open-source software that runs a smart home locally.

prs.title: Time-left text no longer shows 60 minutes
prs.broken: The helpers that print how long ago or how long until something happens rounded the last unit but never carried it over. Results like "1 hour 60 minutes" or "30 days" for just under that appeared.
prs.changed: The rounding now happens first and carries into the next unit, so 59 minutes 45 seconds reads as 1 hour.
prs.matters: Automations and dashboards show durations that read correctly.

prs.title: Smart lights get safe white levels for any color temperature
prs.broken: On lights that mix cold and warm white, asking for a color temperature outside the light's range sent impossible brightness values, and a light with no brightness yet crashed the request.
prs.changed: I kept the temperature inside the light's range and used full brightness when none was known.
prs.matters: Setting a warm or cool white on these lights works instead of sending bad values or failing.
